resources.string: Automatically commit and push local changes

GitSync.md can stage local changes, create commits using each repository’s author identity and upload them for included repositories on their reviewed branch. It never force-pushes, merges diverged histories or switches branches. Turning this off stops future steps; completed commits and uploads remain.

Unreadable Background Sync settings cannot authorize work. Reset removes only its saved policies and health, with both automatic modes off. Repository files, accounts and other sync features are kept. Review each repository again before including it.
